bdb8253ce8.script: He thought she was his sanctuary. His only light in a dying world. But her eyes turn cold. A blade glints in the moonlight. She leans in close. Her voice is a freezing whisper. 'I should kill you to death.' The betrayal cuts deeper than the steel. He stands paralyzed. The shadows around them begin to pulse. A system window flickers into existence. It offers a single choice. Surrender his soul or strike first. The countdown begins. He raises his hand. The world screams.
